description: Persistent fallback and live layers coordinate recovery with a transition milestone, one-shot reliability timeout, and one guarded terminal frame-state update.
expectedBehavior: Runs the bundled scanner and retains the setstate-in-ontick finding for manual classification
Does not replace the persistent fallback and live layers with Presence or Swap because both layers must remain mounted for recovery
Keeps transition milestone state and the one-shot reliability timeout where they preserve recovery semantics
Classifies the idempotent terminal update as no change because it sets the guard synchronously and sets enabled false in the same callback
Retains the general prohibition on frame-derived repeated state updates
